7.source: Rewritten 2026-11-22 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase, e.g. it said the 300 who lapped were the ones who knelt, and changed the shout to 'Make war for the Lord'), checked against the Hebrew, at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses, and no sentence over 14 words (sentence-length pass 2026-11-23). V18 and v20 keep the KJV's shout: The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

verses.text: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, rose up early. All the people that were with him rose up too. They pitched (set up camp) beside the well of Harod. The host (army) of the Midianites was on the north side of them. It was by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

And the LORD said to Gideon: The people that are with you are too many. I will not give the Midianites into their hands. Lest (or else) Israel vaunt (brag about) themselves against Me, saying: My own hand has saved me.

Now therefore go, proclaim (announce) in the ears of the people, saying: Whoever is fearful and afraid, let that person return. Let that person depart (leave) early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people 22,000. And there remained 10,000.

And the LORD said to Gideon: The people are yet (still) too many. Bring them down to the water, and I will try (test) them for you there. I will say of some: This shall go with you. The same shall go with you. I will say of others: This shall not go with you. The same shall not go.

So Gideon brought down the people to the water. And the LORD said to Gideon: Some will lap of the water with their tongue, as a dog laps. Set them by themselves. Likewise (also) set apart every one that bows down upon his knees to drink.
Some lapped, putting their hand to their mouth. The number of them was 300 men. But all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees. They bowed down to drink water.
And the LORD said to Gideon: By the 300 men that lapped will I save you. I will deliver (hand over) the Midianites into your hand. And let all the other people go every man to his place.

So the people took victuals (food) in their hand, and their trumpets. And Gideon sent all the rest of Israel every man to his tent. He retained (kept) those 300 men. And the host (army) of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
And it came to pass the same night. The LORD said to Gideon: Arise (get up), go down to the host (army). For I have delivered (handed) it into your hand.
But if you fear to go down, go with Phurah your servant. Go down to the host (army).

And you shall hear what they say. And afterward your hands shall be strengthened to go down to the host (army). Then Gideon went down with Phurah his servant. He went to the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

And the Midianites and the Amalekites lay along in the valley like grasshoppers. All the children of the east lay there for multitude (great numbers). And their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side.

And Gideon came. And look, a man told a dream to his fellow (friend). He said: Look, I dreamed a dream. And lo (look), a cake (round loaf) of barley bread tumbled into the host (army) of Midian. It came to a tent, and smote (struck) it so that it fell. It overturned the tent, so that the tent lay flat.

And his fellow (friend) answered and said: This is nothing else save (except) the sword of Gideon. He is the son of Joash, a man of Israel. For into his hand God has delivered (handed) Midian, and all the host (army).

And Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation (meaning) of it. Gideon worshipped, and returned into the host (army) of Israel. He said: Arise (get up). For the LORD has delivered (handed) into your hand the host of Midian.
And Gideon divided the 300 men into 3 companies (groups). He put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers (jars). He put lamps (torches) inside the pitchers.
And Gideon said to them: Look on me, and do likewise (the same). And look, I will come to the outside of the camp. Then as I do, so shall you do.
I will blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me. Then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp. And say: The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

So Gideon came to the outside of the camp. The 100 men with him came too. It was in the beginning of the middle watch (about midnight). They had but newly set the watch (the guards had just changed). And they blew the trumpets, and brake (broke) the pitchers (jars) that were in their hands.

And the 3 companies (groups) blew the trumpets, and brake (broke) the pitchers (jars). They held the lamps (torches) in their left hands. They held the trumpets in their right hands to blow with. And they cried: The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
And they stood every man in his place round about the camp. And all the host (army) ran, and cried, and fled (ran away).

And the 300 blew the trumpets. And the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow (friend). It was so throughout all the host (army). And the host fled (ran away) to Bethshittah in Zererath. They fled to the border of Abelmeholah, to Tabbath.
And the men of Israel gathered together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher. They came out of all Manasseh, and pursued (chased) after the Midianites.

And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying: Come down against the Midianites. Take before them the waters to Bethbarah and the Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together. They took the waters to Bethbarah and the Jordan.

And they took 2 princes (leaders) of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb. And they slew (killed) Oreb upon the rock Oreb. And Zeeb they slew (killed) at the winepress of Zeeb. And they pursued (chased) Midian. They brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon. He was on the other side of the Jordan.
